title: Semantic Signal Details
description: Captures a qualified semantic signal extracted from an unstructured source interaction such as a conversation, session, or document. These fields are system-generated and not user-editable.

xdm:semanticSignal.title: Semantic Signal
xdm:semanticSignal.description: A qualified semantic signal extracted from a source interaction.

xdm:name.title: Signal ID
xdm:name.description: Name for the semantic signal. This value is the authoritative key for segmentation and aggregation.

xdm:group.title: Signal Group
xdm:group.description: Human-readable category used to organize related semantic signals.

xdm:score.title: Signal Score
xdm:score.description: Normalized confidence or evidence score for the signal within the source interaction.

xdm:strength.title: Signal Strength
xdm:strength.description: Qualification tier derived from the signal score and configured signal thresholds.

xdm:channel.title: Experience Channel
xdm:channel.description: Channel through which the source interaction occurred.

xdm:sourceId.title: Source ID
xdm:sourceId.description: Identifier of the conversation, session, document, or other source interaction from which the signal was extracted.

xdm:definitionVersion.title: Signal Definition Version
xdm:definitionVersion.description: Version of the semantic signal definition, scoring logic, and qualification thresholds.

xdm:extractionModelVersion.title: Extraction Model Version
xdm:extractionModelVersion.description: Version of the model or extraction system that produced the signal observation.
